items.name: A-character-theatre
items.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create ONE polished 16:9 presentation art-direction mockup image for the Chinese AI voice detective game LIE, not a photographed screen, no laptop/device frame. Existing brand: warm lemon yellow #FFF18A, electric cobalt #075BFA, deep navy #111B45, creamy ivory #FFFEF7, tiny coral accents. References are existing original game characters: preserve their recognisable faces/clothing and 2D illustrated line style, do not make 3D. This is an exploratory style study, not a final slide or factual product screenshot. Prioritize art direction, intentional composition, generous negative space, exquisite typography hierarchy, minimal copy. No generic corporate template, no bullet lists, no rounded-card dashboard, no meaningless tiny copy. Chinese typography should be bold contemporary sans with carefully aligned baseline. Exact title text: '谁在说谎？'. Secondary exact text: '开口，故事才开始。'. Small section marker '01 / 产品'. Small brand wordmark text 'LIE'. Direction A / character theatre: striking high-end illustrated game key art crossed with editorial Swiss typography. Deep navy full-bleed backdrop, huge ivory title at upper left, one crisp cobalt diagonal shaft of stage light and a quiet lemon-yellow circular backdrop. Two reference characters cropped dramatically waist-up, overlapping the lower/right composition as if facing a question; exaggerated SCALE not excessive effects. Title area breathes, text occupies no more than 25%. A single elegant thin sound waveform in lemon subtly connects their speaking space. Flat saturated color, crisp edges, restrained shadow, visual confidence, lively but sophisticated. Do not scatter icons/stickers.

items.name: C-technical-inner
items.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. ONE polished 16:9 slide mockup for art direction exploration of LIE Chinese AI detective game pitch. This is a speculative visual concept, not final factual material. Same editorial visual language as supplied reference: ivory warm white #FFFEF7, navy #111B45, cobalt #075BFA, lemon yellow #FFF18A, tiny coral red. Beautiful contemporary oversized Chinese sans typography, restrained art direction and ample whitespace, precise asymmetric editorial grid, flat illustration with crisp navy outlines. Avoid corporate flowchart, bullet list, dashboard cards, random ornaments, code screenshot walls, pseudo-technical neon, tiny illegible copy. Brand mark use small plain text 'LIE', not a redesigned logo. Make graphics explain relationships spatially and be the hero of the slide, text concise. TECHNICAL INNER PAGE. Small section marker '02 / 技术'. Main title exact: '产品开放动作，\nAgent 负责推理'. Create a visually clever editorial exploded diagram, like a beautiful cutaway of a cream/yellow browser editor panel at right (symbolic UI, no fake testimonials or metrics), containing three crisp horizontal field strokes, with a navy Agent symbol shaped as a simple speech bubble at left. Between them ONE beautifully oversized cobalt arrow cut through a yellow circular aperture, labelled 'WebMCP'. At the bottom of editor, visibly connected folded sheet labelled '本地草稿'. The diagram should read user-agent -> page editing actions -> saved draft, not cloud game server, with huge visual scale and delightful precise joins. Bottom one-line caption exact: '复用编辑器，也为用户自己的 Agent 留出入口。'. Text may be simplified but all required Chinese text should be exact; no extra text.
